mapper.select: SELECT id FROM picture WHERE isDelete = 0 AND reviewStatus = 1 AND spaceId IS NULL

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.url, p.thumbnailUrl, p.picWidth, p.picHeight, p.categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, p.spaceId, p.userId, p.tags, p.reviewStatus, p.createTime, COALESCE(ps.likeCount, 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE(ps.favoriteCount, 0) AS favoriteCount, COALESCE(ps.shareCount, 0) AS shareCount, COALESCE(ps.viewCount, 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(ps.downloadCount, 0) AS downloadCount FROM picture p LEFT JOIN picture_statistics ps ON p.id = ps.pictureId LEFT JOIN category c ON p.categoryId = c.id WHERE p.isDelete = 0 AND p.reviewStatus = 1 AND p.spaceId IS NULL ORDER BY p.hotScore DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT p.id, p.name, p.url, p.thumbnailUrl, p.picWidth, p.picHeight, p.categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, p.spaceId, p.userId, p.tags, p.reviewStatus, p.createTime, COALESCE(ps.likeCount, 0) AS likeCount, COALESCE(ps.favoriteCount, 0) AS favoriteCount, COALESCE(ps.shareCount, 0) AS shareCount, COALESCE(ps.viewCount, 0) AS viewCount, COALESCE(ps.downloadCount, 0) AS downloadCount FROM picture p LEFT JOIN picture_statistics ps ON p.id = ps.pictureId LEFT JOIN category c ON p.categoryId = c.id WHERE p.isDelete = 0 AND p.reviewStatus = 1 AND p.spaceId IS NULL AND p.categoryId = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.hotScore DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
